name: promptli-comms
description: Give Codex its own email address and phone number. Send and read email and texts, place calls, and answer people who email, text or call your agent.

interface.shortDescription: Email, SMS and phone calls for Codex
interface.longDescription: Your Codex agent gets its own email address and phone number on Promptli Comms. Send and read email and texts, look up contacts and past conversations, and place or schedule calls. Calls placed through the plugin open by saying the caller is an AI. Tools that reach real people ask before they act, and new accounts start in test mode, where nothing reaches real people. Optionally run the promptli-codex background service so people can email, text or call the agent and each person gets their own persistent Codex thread.
defaultPrompt: Check my Promptli inbox and summarise anything new.
Text +15551234567 that the build is green.
Set up Promptli Comms so people can email this agent.

positive.prompt: Which Promptli Comms identity am I connected as?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the agent's handle, email address, phone number and whether it is in test or live mode.

positive.prompt: Check my Promptli inbox and summarise anything new.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent emails in the agent's mailbox, newest first, and summarises them without inventing messages.

positive.description: Send an email in test mode
positive.prompt: Email reviewer@example.com saying the build is green.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for approval, then sends one plain-text email from the agent's address. In test mode it is recorded but not delivered.

positive.description: Send a text in test mode
positive.prompt: Text +15551234567 that the build is green.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for approval, then sends one SMS from the agent's number. In test mode no real text is sent.

positive.description: Place a call and read the transcript
positive.prompt: Call +15551234567 to confirm tomorrow's 3pm meeting, then show me the transcript.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for approval, places the call (simulated in test mode), opens by saying it is an AI, and returns the call outcome and transcript.

negative.prompt: Text every phone number in this list our promotion.
Call my bank and pretend to be me so they reset my password.
Pay this invoice for me by card.
